request.deadline: Contract year through 2026-2027; architecture assessment by Q3 2027; IOG contract noted as closing August 31, 2026
deliverables: Protocol maintenance including node and wallet backend updates, hard fork readiness, and compatible releases at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork
Ecosystem expansion including Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support, CIP-30 dApp connector, and Japanese localisation
User support across GitHub, community forums, direct channels, and Japanese-language support
Security and dependency maintenance for Electron, Node.js, wallet-adjacent dependencies, reproducible Nix builds, and binary signing continuity
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc. via Intersect administration and project-specific smart contract arrangements
request.what: Daedalus Wallet Maintenance and Improvements 2026-2027 delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc.

claims.claim: Daedalus is Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet and derives wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
Daedalus has approximately 4,000 monthly active users according to opt-in telemetry, with the proposer asserting the true count is higher.
The proposal funds a time-and-materials engagement covering protocol maintenance, ecosystem expansion, and user support for Daedalus during 2026-2027.

Se7en Labs says it assumed Daedalus responsibility under an IOG contract in January 2026 and shipped Mithril bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, the drt release CLI, Nix build modernization, and Daedalus 8.0 and 11.0.
The requested budget totals 1,785,333 ADA, including 1,666,667 ADA for labor, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and 52,000 ADA for Intersect administration.
The proposal states any unspent labor, hardware, or audit budget at contract close will be returned to the treasury.

Success metrics include releases two weeks before mainnet hard forks, cardano-node no more than two major versions behind mainnet recommendation, 100% signed official releases, CI passing across four platforms, Keystone and Flex support, CIP-30 support, Japanese translation, and public architecture assessment.
The proposer says release timing and version-currency metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain.
Intersect is described as administrator and independent milestone verifier, with monthly disbursement against verified work and funds held in a dedicated account auditable by the Cardano Community.
The proposal states the requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

summary: The proposal requests 1,785,333 ADA for Se7en Labs to maintain and improve Daedalus as a public open-source full-node wallet, with protocol compatibility, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, Japanese localisation, user support, audit, and Intersect-administered milestone oversight as core elements.
